# Groundlayer AV Consulting

## What we do
CTS-D + CTS-I certified AV design, integration, and commissioning for courtrooms, government facilities, law firms, schools, and enterprise spaces. Based in Kansas City, MO. Currently operating Jackson County Courts AV.

## Who it's for
- Courtroom and government AV departments
- School districts (classrooms, auditoriums, stadiums)
- Law firms upgrading conference room technology
- Corporate facilities needing reliable hybrid meeting rooms
- Architects and general contractors needing AV specification

## Pricing
Projects typically $25,000–$200,000. Design-only and commissioning-only engagements available.

## Services
- **Conference Rooms & Offices** — Teams Rooms, Zoom Rooms, Google Meet, Webex, cameras, microphones, displays, room control
- **Schools, Auditoriums & Stadiums** — Classroom AV, auditorium projection/sound, performing arts, athletic audio, district deployments
- **Law Firms & Courtrooms** — Evidence presentation, judge/attorney UC, multi-camera video, assistive listening, recording, courtroom control
- **Portable Media Carts** — Mobile conferencing systems for IT and facilities teams
- **Commissioning & Handoff** — As-built schematics, cable schedules, O&M docs, user training, validation workflows

## Technical platforms
Q-SYS, Extron, Biamp, BSS, Crestron, AMX, Microsoft Teams Rooms, Zoom Rooms, Google Meet, Webex, Cisco, L-Acoustics, d&b, ETC lighting, DMX, AV-over-IP (TCP/IP, VLAN, multicast)

## Credentials
AVIXA CTS, CTS-I, CTS-D | Q-SYS Level 2 | Extron Pro | ETC Lighting Certified | Biamp | BSS Audio | L-Acoustics | d&b | OSHA 10

## Selected clients
Jackson County MO Courts · Kauffman Center for the Performing Arts · Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City · Kansas City Convention Center · Kansas City School District · Liberty School District · St. Joseph School District · Raytown School District · Blue Springs School District · Starlight Auditorium · American Jazz Museum · The Music Hall · Gem Theater · Orpheum Theatre · City of Kansas City · Overland Park Convention Center · Bartle Hall
